summary: The aa002e78..4b357a37 diff is plan-docs plus first-review/audit evidence logs only; no product, wire, dependency, or test-owner code changes. All five first-round blockers close against the actual owners: (1) post-transfer failure semantics are restated honestly — the premise is real (v3-live.ts:7261 sets existing.active=false at transport reuse before terminalizeSource at :7383), and the corrected plan confines usable-predecessor retention to pre-transfer refusals, tears down the successor once, leaves no false active entry, releases the lock only after teardown, and assigns pending recovery to D.110c-0c with no v3-live restore owner; (2) replacement now marks the owner/token in-flight before its first await, defers deactivation/lock release, and performs an exact CAS immediately before activeOwners.set, with mismatch/retirement deactivating the new plane, removing only the still-matching entry, and failing closed — mid-flight shutdown can neither install an unlocked successor nor delete a later owner; (3) the duplicate-adoption predicate is executable: successor-pending-adoption always proceeds while authority/floor sit at the predecessor, active is a no-op only with exact authority/stable-floor/active-plane tuple agreement and no pending successor, and sealed/successor-adopted fail closed; (4) retained epoch-1 oracles are verified exact in source (tests/fixtures/phase-6a-v3/creator-successor-product-contract.ts:560-574 record.epoch === 1 with D108D2_AUTHORITY_KEYS; raw derivation at packages/storage-browser/tests/assets/phase-6a-creator-successor-product-entry.ts:682 filtering currentEpoch === 1 and :702 emitting literal epoch: 1), and the plan mandates a separate tests-only isD110cBSuccessorAuthority(value, expectedEpoch) plus separate raw derivation without loosening the retained controls; (5) the pinned evidence is now committed and validates: .logs/d110c-b-plan-audit-3118da76/{audit.md,source-shape.txt,manifest.sha256} match the plan's recorded SHA-256 pins (61d34473…, 49bb0fc6…, 1ea2c137…), and the review manifest f2a5bb67… plus review-ledger 081229e4… both verify cleanly (shasum -c OK on all entries). P2 dispositions also check out: Node gate is map-custody-only with no synthetic navigator.locks and lock uniqueness moved to Chromium; the new Chromium title is appended after the retained serial chain (phase-6a-creator-successor-product.pw.ts:662) with a distinct fourth realm/database/channel (d110c-b-hot-creator / d110c-b-hot-rollover) and unchanged-retained-realm snapshots; same-head idempotence is minted from the genuine active-new producer verified at packages/node/src/creator-adoption-commit.ts:684; close bind occurs only after predecessor deactivation succeeds, never routes through throwAfterReplacementCleanup (examples/v3-room/src/index.ts:3557-3582), retains D110C_B_CLOSE_REBIND_FAILED truthful custody, and post-transfer activation failure is exact D110C_B_ACTIVATION_STALLED with no stale-predecessor claim; creator-adoption.ts:1030 (successorProjection.record.epoch !== 1 in the cold-reopen owner, verified) is added to the 0b1/c debt list with retained epoch-2 cold reopen asserted fail-closed as chain-invalid; and the Phase-5e owner is correctly renamed to the anonymous inline sealEpoch() result declaration (verified at phase-5e-creator-live-close.pw.ts:249-262). No correction requires a new public key/method, wire/schema field, dependency, crypto/authority assumption, threshold/workload change, cold-reopen implementation, long campaign, or D.110a rerun. Blocking union is empty; RED may proceed under the plan's gates.
